value.text: The common envelope requires an object, string id, version 1, a place with id oslo, helsinki, or lisbon, string name, and finite latitude and longitude. The forecast branch requires updatedAt and fetchedAt accepted by isTimestamp, mode fixture or live, and a periods array of length 1 through 6. Each period requires a valid time, finite temperatureC, precipitationMm null or finite and nonnegative, and a string symbol. isTimestamp accepts a UTC ISO-like value with seconds and optional fractional seconds, and also requires Date.parse to be finite.
